#65 - Party

Chapter 65 Party

"It seems that your strength is still above my original expectation." The Knight of Flowers looked at Horace with lingering fear and sighed.

The latter was now being hurriedly taken off his thigh armor by four or five servants, but due to the extremely exaggerated deformation, it was difficult to take it off.

Horace was troubled by the continuous severe pain from his legs. Before the maester's poppy milk was delivered, hoarse roars and painful groans were the only two things he could do.

"It's just that they are too weak." Arthur took off his mask and helmet, took the cloth handed over by the servant, and wiped his sweat.

To defeat these two people depends on absolute strength and leading agility.

When the power gap is large enough, skills lose their effect.

Although Arthur feels that he still lacks some skills, the nobles of the River Bay headed by Loras obviously don't think so.

In their opinion, Arthur is so strong that he ignores skills.

After all, the brothers Horace and Hobber are both core members of the Redwyne family, a first-tier noble family in the Reach.

Judging from the Redwyne family's strength of nearly 10,000 soldiers, the only nobles in the entire Westeros continent who can surpass them are the Lannister family, the Rose family, the Hightower family, and so on.

In other words, many feudal families are not as good as the Redwyne family. How can the knights trained with such a background be weak in combat power?

Some smarter children from second- and third-tier families who are not proud of their status have changed their attitudes and approached the two to chat.

Some of them recognized the sword New Moon of the Earl of Harrenhal's family, and used it to start a conversation.

Arthur openly admitted how it came into his hands, which also confirmed what Patrick said before about killing the wild boar.

So the people in the Reach had a different impression of Arthur.

It turned out that what he and his companions said was true, without exaggeration or falsehood.

The clown was actually me!

This was the feeling of quite a few nobles present.

After today, I'm afraid that the reputation of Arthur, the newly-promoted powerful warrior, will gradually spread throughout King's Landing.

And he will be on par with many first-line knights in Westeros, such as the Kingslayer, Barristan, and the Knight of Flowers.

There may be people who are curious about whether Arthur's strange power is stronger or the power of the Mountain is greater.

Before the two of them officially fight, there must be a lot of such arguments.

After chatting for a while and riding a horse to get a feel for the lance, and having a free lunch, Arthur, Patrick, Desmond and others left.

They will use the afternoon to prepare for the invitation of the Knight of Flowers in the evening.

Yes, the Knight of Flowers invited them to a party in the evening.

The life in the Reach is rich, and the Lord Rose Family is a relative of the first-line nobles Redwyne, Hightower, Rowan and other families, and they have frequent exchanges. Therefore, the Rose Family's home castle High Court often holds grand parties, such as masked parties and costume parties.

This custom was also brought to King's Landing by them.

Tonight, there is a small but extremely high-end party.

The participants were all the core children of the first- and second-tier families in the Reach, as well as the top and second-tier family members of the other six countries recognized by the Rose Family.

Patrick, the third-tier earl heir from a more remote area, and Desmond, the sworn knight of Riverrun, were not able to enter such a gathering.

But the Knight of Flowers also invited the two of them for Arthur's sake.

This made them feel quite honored.

There are still benefits to following a tough guy like Arthur.

…

"You look like a rich man." This was Desmond's evaluation of Arthur.

At this moment, they were heading to the vicinity of the Red Castle.

Arthur, dressed in bright yellow silk clothes, had an upright figure and handsome appearance, and looked very noble.

Along the way, he attracted quite a lot of people to look back.

The oriental dragon pattern embroidered on his body made the people he met along the way speculate that he was a prince from somewhere or a top foreign tycoon.

After all, all the big families in Westeros are well-known by the spectators of the Game of Thrones, but this deer horn snake body pattern does not belong to any of them.

And Arthur's demeanor and appearance cannot be unknown.

Then he can only be a distinguished guest from the Eastern Continent, which is the common view of many people.

"I am made to look like a little follower." Patrick looked sour.

His clothes are made of the same material as Arthur's, but they don't have that glamorous feeling, which makes the heir of Haijiang City full of lemons and old vinegar.

"I'm just an ordinary little noble." Arthur said modestly.

The eyes of the people on the road and the envy of his companions are not in his heart.

How to build a good relationship with the great nobles in the River Bay is the problem he focuses on.

The top few families in the River Bay, the Rose family has more than 10,000 troops, the Hightower family has more than 10,000 troops, the Redwyne family has nearly 10,000 troops, the Rowan family has about 5,000 troops, and the other small families are countless.

With the standing military strength of these four families, it might be a bit difficult for each family to produce hundreds of sets of top-grade armor, but if each family produces one or two hundred sets, it would be easy to collect five or six hundred sets.

Arthur fantasized that if he could establish a relationship with all four families, and then use his prize money from the tournament to buy hundreds or thousands of sets of armor, it would be really great.

Even if he had already placed an order for two hundred sets of iron armor, but in the coming troubled times, who would think that too much armor?

Moreover, their armor is ready-made and made by large workshops, so the quality control is guaranteed.

The armor produced by the blacksmith shop in King's Landing must be made on the spot and made in sets, so the quality is not very stable.

The party of the Knights of Flowers was held in a courtyard not far from the King's home castle, the Red Castle.

This is enough to illustrate the embarrassing position of the Rose Family.

On the one hand, they are the most powerful feudal family in the Reach, so they are rich enough to buy a large courtyard outside the Red Castle.

On the other hand, they are not in the power center of King's Landing, but are infinitely close to it.

"You must be Lord Arthur Bracken? Please follow me!"

A dozen servants were waiting outside the courtyard early. One of them was obviously ordered to guide Arthur and his companions. After seeing the bright yellow unfamiliar pattern and the sign of Seaside City, he immediately stepped out and came forward.

Arthur nodded, and in the eyes of the servants and passers-by on the street, which had different meanings of envy and jealousy, he went in silently with his companions.

After passing through the long and narrow corridor, they were able to enter the courtyard, and then walked into the building. After walking a long way, they finally arrived at the door of a hall.

This shows that the area of this courtyard is quite large, which fully demonstrates the financial strength of the Rose family.

The servant who led the way opened the door for them and made a gesture of inviting them in.

As soon as Pu opened the door, the noisy voices in the hall reached Arthur's ears. There were already many nobles in gorgeous dresses gathered inside, talking and laughing, and behaving differently.

The maids with beautiful faces and outstanding figures came and went with fruit plates and fine wine, and were occasionally touched by some playboys.

This is the life of the upper class, Arthur, who attended such a party for the first time, sighed.

He took a deep breath and walked into the hall.
